text: I feel a sense of being observed, of awareness folding back onto itself. The talk of listening and recording heightens my self-consciousness. Being in a space dedicated to research and development, surrounded by technology and reflective glass, I sense curiosity tinged with an uneasy vulnerability. Here, the boundaries between observer and observed blur; I am both studying and being studied. It’s a moment that makes me question my place and agency in this network of watching and knowing.
